courses.title: Associate Developer / Data Modeler
courses.summary: Master the fundamentals of MongoDB development and data modeling. Learn to design efficient schemas, write performant queries, and build scalable applications.

slides.heading: Course Overview
slides.body: This comprehensive 2-day training provides hands-on experience with MongoDB development practices and data modeling principles. You'll learn how to design flexible schemas that align with application access patterns and leverage MongoDB's document model effectively.

slides.heading: Who Should Attend
bullets: Engineers responsible for database schema design
Technical leads evaluating MongoDB for projects

slides.heading: Key Topics
bullets: Document model fundamentals and BSON types

slides.heading: Learning Outcomes
bullets: Design schemas aligned with application requirements
Write efficient queries using MongoDB Query Language
Understand when to embed vs. reference documents
Build aggregation pipelines for complex data transformations

courses.title: Associate Atlas Administrator
courses.summary: Become proficient in managing MongoDB Atlas deployments. Learn cluster configuration, security best practices, monitoring, and operational workflows for cloud-based MongoDB.

slides.heading: Course Overview
slides.body: This intensive 2-day course covers everything needed to successfully deploy and manage MongoDB Atlas clusters in production. From initial setup to advanced operational tasks, you'll gain hands-on experience with Atlas's full feature set.

slides.heading: Who Should Attend
bullets: System administrators new to MongoDB Atlas
Platform engineers responsible for data services

slides.heading: Learning Outcomes
bullets: Deploy and configure Atlas clusters for various workloads
Monitor cluster health and performance metrics
Execute backup and disaster recovery procedures
Scale clusters to meet changing demands

courses.title: Associate Database Administrator
courses.summary: Deep dive into MongoDB administration for self-managed deployments. Cover installation, replica sets, sharding, backup/recovery, and production operations.

slides.heading: Course Overview
slides.body: This advanced 2-day training focuses on administering self-managed MongoDB deployments. You'll learn to configure replica sets, implement sharding, and manage all aspects of production MongoDB infrastructure.

slides.heading: Who Should Attend
bullets: Technical operators transitioning from other databases

slides.heading: Key Topics
bullets: Backup strategies: mongodump, snapshots, and continuous backup

slides.heading: Learning Outcomes
bullets: Deploy and manage replica sets in production
Apply security best practices for self-managed deployments

courses.title: AI Masterclass
courses.summary: Explore MongoDB's AI capabilities including vector search, semantic search, and building AI-powered applications. Learn to integrate MongoDB with modern AI/ML workflows.

slides.heading: Course Overview
slides.body: This cutting-edge 2-day masterclass explores how MongoDB powers modern AI applications. Learn to implement vector search, build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems, and integrate MongoDB with AI/ML frameworks.

slides.heading: Who Should Attend
bullets: Data scientists working with vector embeddings
Product managers exploring AI use cases

slides.heading: Key Topics
bullets: Storing and querying embeddings at scale
Integrating with OpenAI, LangChain, and other frameworks

slides.heading: Learning Outcomes
bullets: Implement vector search for semantic queries
Build RAG systems using MongoDB as knowledge base
Design schemas optimized for AI workloads
Integrate MongoDB with popular AI frameworks
